fix_1_unichain_request_schema.bug: fetch_pool_info.py sent poolReferences: [{poolReferenceIdentifier: ...}] but the official schema field is poolReferences[0].referenceIdentifier; server treated it as empty and returned 400 invalid_argument
fix_1_unichain_request_schema.fix: changed the request body key to referenceIdentifier
fix_1_unichain_request_schema.verified_by: unit test only (tests/test_offline.py::TestPoolReferenceRequestSchema); NOT yet re-verified against a real request in this environment (no UNISWAP_API_KEY here) -- anne must re-run fetch_pool_info.py to confirm the two Unichain queries actually succeed now
fix_1_unichain_request_schema.caveat: anne separately confirmed 0x267EE34200b09Ea8b52D02EeC3300b84985B1eFd is a wallet address, not a pool; pool_info cannot resolve wallet->pool, so this target may still fail after the schema fix. Real V3/V4 wallet position lookup is out of scope here (handed to a separate research card) and must not be reported as a delivered pool.

fix_2_covered_keys_token_order.bug: normalize.py::covered_keys() built its key from the API response's token_a_symbol/token_b_symbol (order decided by the server), while build_pending_rows() built its key from the request's base_symbol/quote_symbol (order decided by our config); when the server returned the pair in reversed order the keys never matched, so already-answered combos were re-labeled pending
fix_2_covered_keys_token_order.fix: added _canonical_pair() (order-independent sorted tuple) and made both covered_keys() and _pending_key() use it
fix_2_covered_keys_token_order.verified_by: re-ran scripts/normalize.py against anne's real data/latest_raw.json from this round: pending_rows 61->0, total_rows 292->231 (duplicate rows eliminated); also 2 new offline unit/integration tests (tests/test_offline.py::TestCoveredKeysIgnoreTokenOrder)
